target: FARELY INTERNAL PRODUCT & ENGINEERING READINESS = MAXIMUM DEFENSIBLE STATE

immutable_invariants.name: ONE_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY
immutable_invariants.rule: Every material concept has one canonical semantic authority.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_SHADOW_ARCHITECTURE
immutable_invariants.rule: A replacement is not complete until actual production readers/writers use it and old authority is retired.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_INTENT_LOSS
immutable_invariants.rule: Supported TravelIntent semantics cannot disappear between UI, API, Watch, Saved and decision logic.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_GLOBAL_CLAIM_FROM_PARTIAL_UNIVERSE
immutable_invariants.rule: Cheapest, best, no match, no cheaper option and equivalent global claims require complete eligible scope or explicit bounded scope.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_EPISTEMIC_UPGRADE
immutable_invariants.rule: A later layer cannot make data appear more certain than its evidence.

immutable_invariants.name: UNKNOWN_REMAINS_UNKNOWN
immutable_invariants.rule: Unknown cost != zero. Provider failure != empty. Partial data != complete. Observed != verified.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_STATE_TRANSITION_FROM_INCOMPLETE_WATCH_EVALUATION
immutable_invariants.rule: Incomplete data cannot produce ENTER/EXIT/no-match/success transition.

immutable_invariants.name: DURABLE_INTENT_BEFORE_EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT
immutable_invariants.rule: Email/Telegram side effects require durable committed notification intent.

immutable_invariants.name: EXACT_RELEASE_PROOF
immutable_invariants.rule: Final proof belongs to the exact source/schema/runtime it certifies.

immutable_invariants.name: NO_SELF_CERTIFICATION
immutable_invariants.rule: Executor cannot assign PROVEN merely because it authored the implementation.

immutable_invariants.name: CURRENT_REQUIREMENT_AUTHORITY
immutable_invariants.rule: Requirements may be SUPERSEDED by stronger current external requirements but may not silently disappear.

immutable_invariants.name: PRESERVE_WORKING_BEHAVIOR
immutable_invariants.rule: Do not break already-correct required flows while converging architecture.

amendment_process: Architectural decisions may be reopened only if empirical evidence proves design unsafe/inferior, documented with preserved invariants and durable state update.
